facts.fact: 139 is Indian Railways' integrated helpline (Rail Madad)
facts.quote: Send Facebook post to RailMadad 139 – Integrated Helpline

facts.fact: From 1 January 2020 the earlier separate helplines (138, 1800111321, 1072, 152210, 58888, 9717630982) were discontinued and integrated helpline 139 took over
facts.quote: will be discontinued and INTEGRATED RAILWAY HELPLINE 139 will take over all existing Helpline numbers.

facts.fact: Helpline 139 is integrated with the Emergency Response Support System (ERSS) number 112
facts.quote: For immediate assistance, passengers can make complaint on Rail Madad Portal directly or through Helpline Number 139 [integrated with Emergency Response Support System (ERSS) No.112].

facts.fact: 139 IVR options: 1 security or medical assistance; 2 enquiry; 3 catering complaints; 4 general complaints; 5 bribery and corruption; 6 accident information; 7 IRCTC Tejas Express assistance; 9 status of complaint; * operator
facts.quote: Security Helpline or Medical Assistance ( 1 ) · Enquiry ( 2 ) · Catering Complaints ( 3 ) · General Complaints ( 4 ) · Bribery & Corruption ( 5 ) · Accident Information ( 6 ) · Assistance related to IRCTC - Tejas Express ( 7 ) · Status of your Complaint ( 9 ) · For Operator ( * )

facts.fact: Complaints can also be sent by SMS to 139
facts.quote: SMS - MADAD (space) "C omplaint Description" send to 139

facts.fact: Complaints can also be lodged on the Rail Madad website (railmadad.indianrailways.gov.in) or app, or via social media @RailMadad
facts.quote: RailMadad website ( https://railmadad.indianrailways.gov.in/madad/final/home.jsp ) · RailMadad App · Tweet to @RailMadad · Send Facebook post to RailMadad

summary: All facts confirmed: 139 integrated helpline with IVR options, SMS, Rail Madad web/app/@RailMadad (WR helpline page), old numbers replaced from 01.01.2020 (SR notice), integrated with ERSS 112 (PIB 27.11.2024).
